b.d0e18d7008:
<h>Hymnus</h>
<c>Q</c>uæ vox, quæ póterit lingua retéxere,
Quæ tu Martyribus múnera prǽparas?
Rubri nam flúido sánguine láureis
Ditántur bene fúlgidis.

<h>T</h>e summa Déitas únaque póscimus,
Ut culpas ábluas, nóxia súbtrahas,
Des pacem fámulis, nos quoque glóriam
Per cuncta tibi sǽcula.
Amen.
b.15112529e8:
<h>Hymn</h>
<c>W</c>hat joys, bright with the blood shed for thy love they share,
Those brave martyrs of thine crowned with thy laurels rare;
Man's tongue never can tell, never can half declare,
How pure now is their bliss above!

<h>Y</h>et we, Father on high, God of eternal might,
Lift weak voices in prayer asking for peace and light;
Cleanse thou out of our hearts every stain and blight,
So our songs may be songs of love.
Amen.

<h>Lectio 1</h>
De Ieremía Prophéta
<r>Ier 31:15-17</r>
<n>15</n> Hæc dicit Dóminus: Vox in excélso audíta est lamentatiónis, luctus, et fletus Rachel plorántis fílios suos, et noléntis consolári super eis, quia non sunt.
<n>16</n> Hæc dicit Dóminus: Quiéscat vox tua a plorátu, et óculi tui a lácrimis: quia est merces óperi tuo, ait Dóminus: et reverténtur de terra inimíci.
<n>17</n> Et est spes novíssimis tuis, ait Dóminus: et reverténtur fílii ad términos suos.
<h>H</h>æc dicit Dóminus Deus: Convertímini ad me, et salvi éritis.
<r>℟.</r> Deo grátias.

<r>℟.</r> Sub altáre Dei audívi voces occisórum dicéntium: Quare non deféndis sánguinem nostrum? Et accepérunt divínum respónsum: Adhuc sustinéte módicum tempus, donec impleátur númerus fratrum vestrórum.
<r>℣.</r> Et datæ sunt illis singulæ stolæ albæ: et dictum est illis.
<r>℟.</r> Adhuc sustinéte módicum tempus, donec impleátur númerus fratrum vestrórum.

<h>Reading 1</h>
Lesson from the book of Jeremias
<r>Jer 31:15-17</r>
<n>15</n> Thus saith the Lord: A voice was heard on high of lamentation, of mourning, and weeping, of Rachel weeping for her children, and refusing to be comforted for them, because they are not.
<n>16</n> Thus saith the Lord: Let thy voice cease from weeping, and thy eyes from tears: for there is a reward for thy work, saith the Lord: and they shall return out of the land of the enemy.
<n>17</n> And here is hope for thy last end, saith the Lord: and the children shall return to their own borders.
<h>H</h>æc dicit Dóminus Deus: Convertímini ad me, et salvi éritis.
<r>℟.</r> Thanks be to God.

<r>℟.</r> I heard under the altar the voices of them that were slain, saying: How long dost Thou not avenge our blood? And it was said unto them from God: Rest yet for a little season, until the number of your brethren be fulfilled.
<r>℣.</r> Et datæ sunt illis singulæ stolæ albæ: et dictum est illis.
<r>℟.</r> Rest yet for a little season, until the number of your brethren be fulfilled.

<r>Te Deum</r>
<c>T</c>e Deum laudámus: * te Dóminum confitémur.
Te ætérnum Patrem * omnis terra venerátur.
Tibi omnes Ángeli, * tibi Cæli, et univérsæ Potestátes:
Tibi Chérubim et Séraphim * incessábili voce proclámant:
<n>(Fit reverentia)</n> Sanctus, Sanctus, Sanctus * Dóminus Deus Sábaoth.
Pleni sunt cæli et terra * maiestátis glóriæ tuæ.
Te gloriósus * Apostolórum chorus,
Te Prophetárum * laudábilis númerus,
Te Mártyrum candidátus * laudat exércitus.
Te per orbem terrárum * sancta confitétur Ecclésia,
Patrem * imménsæ maiestátis;
Venerándum tuum verum * et únicum Fílium;
Sanctum quoque * Paráclitum Spíritum.
Tu Rex glóriæ, * Christe.
Tu Patris * sempitérnus es Fílius.
<n>(Fit reverentia)</n> Tu, ad liberándum susceptúrus hóminem: * non horruísti Vírginis úterum.
